2. Functions of the Council.
The Council shall
have the following duties and functions:
a. Formulate and adopt an intograted em-

industry development as component of the over

b. Correlate the functions of the agencios

ment with emphasis on generating massive employ-
ment opportunities for the unemployed and the
underomployed;

Study and formulate such functions as shall

The Enterpriso shall servo as implementing agency

tage Industrios Development Authority shall serve as

4. The CIDE, with the approval of the Council,
